records.source: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Marlon 66 15 2/broadcastEvent/skippable/pause 1000/move farmer -1 0 2/move farmer 0 1 1/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 12/pause 1000/speak Marlon "Bumped into Robin this morning... she told me you've got a new Slime Hutch!"/showFrame Marlon 8/shake Marlon 1600/textAboveHead Marlon "Not bad!"/pause 1600/showFrame Marlon 12/pause 500/speak Marlon "I was into slime breeding at your age. It's a great hobby... but dangerous.#$b#How'd you think I lost this eye?"/shake Marlon 1000/showFrame Marlon 12/textAboveHead Marlon "Hah!"/pause 1000/textAboveHead Marlon "Just Kidding."/showFrame Marlon 12/pause 200/showFrame Marlon 7/animate Marlon false false 120 4 5 6 7/pause 800/speak Marlon "Here, I've got something for you."/faceDirection farmer 2/itemAboveHead slimeEgg/pause 1000/pause 1000/pause 1300/awardFestivalPrize slimeEgg/pause 300/faceDirection farmer 1 true/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 12/speak Marlon "It's a slime egg. You can place that inside a slime incubator to hatch it.#$b#Now, take a good hard look at that egg. Next time you're out slime-hunting keep your eyes peeled for more eggs. They're rare, but slimes do drop them from time to time.#$b#Collect eggs from different slimes to add some variety to your herd!"/pause 500/end
records.translation: continue/64 15/farmer 64 16 2 Marlon 66 15 2/broadcastEvent/skippable/pause 1000/move farmer -1 0 2/move farmer 0 1 1/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 12/pause 1000/speak Marlon "Nakasalubong ko si Robin kaninang umaga... sinabi niyang mayroon kang bagong Bahay ng Slime!"/showFrame Marlon 8/shake Marlon 1600/textAboveHead Marlon "Hindi masama!"/pause 1600/showFrame Marlon 12/pause 500/speak Marlon "Mahilig akong magparami ng mga Slime noong kasing-edad mo ako. Magandang libangan iyon... pero mapanganib.#$b#Paano sa tingin mo nawala ang mata kong ito?"/shake Marlon 1000/showFrame Marlon 12/textAboveHead Marlon "Ha!"/pause 1000/textAboveHead Marlon "Nagbibiro lang."/showFrame Marlon 12/pause 200/showFrame Marlon 7/animate Marlon false false 120 4 5 6 7/pause 800/speak Marlon "Heto, may ibibigay ako sa iyo."/faceDirection farmer 2/itemAboveHead slimeEgg/pause 1000/pause 1000/pause 1300/awardFestivalPrize slimeEgg/pause 300/faceDirection farmer 1 true/pause 500/showFrame Marlon 12/speak Marlon "Itlog ito ng Slime. Maaari mo itong ilagay sa loob ng Pampapisa ng Slime upang mapisa.#$b#Ngayon, tingnan mong mabuti ang itlog na iyon. Sa susunod na mangaso ka ng mga Slime, magmatyag para sa iba pang itlog. Bihira ang mga iyon, pero paminsan-minsan ay naglalaglag ng itlog ang mga Slime.#$b#Mangolekta ng mga itlog mula sa iba't ibang Slime upang magkaroon ng sari-saring uri ang alaga mong pangkat!"/pause 500/end
records.englishResidueReason: Slime is the canonical retained creature name; event commands and item identifiers remain unchanged.

records.source: WizardSong/2 14/farmer 3 14 3 Wizard 1 14 1/skippable/pause 1000/speak Wizard "You've found my ink! Excellent."/move Wizard 1 0 1/pause 1000/speak Wizard "Er..."/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 500/showFrame Wizard 18/pause 500/speak Wizard "Did you... happen to see my ex-wife?#$b#No? Well, what about her house...?#$b#Do you think she lives alone? Or...$h"/pause 500/showFrame Wizard 0/emote Wizard 12/pause 500/faceDirection Wizard 3/pause 500/speak Wizard "...Actually, don't tell me... I don't want to know."/pause 500/pause 500/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 500/speak Wizard "Anyway... you must be wondering about your reward. Here..."/move Wizard -1 0 1/pause 800/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 1000/showFrame Wizard 16/pause 800/specificTemporarySprite arcaneBook/playSound fireball/shake Wizard 500/pause 4000/faceDirection farmer 0/faceDirection Wizard 1/faceDirection Wizard 0/pause 500/speak Wizard "It's a book of summoning.#$b#The arcane potential is immense... but I'll make it simple for you.#$b#By using this book, you can summon magic buildings directly to your farm.#$b#I think you'll find it useful."/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 3/faceDirection Wizard 1/speak Wizard "Oh, I almost forgot to say... ahem... Thank you."/pause 1000/emote farmer 32/pause 800/end
records.translation: WizardSong/2 14/farmer 3 14 3 Wizard 1 14 1/skippable/pause 1000/speak Wizard "Nahanap mo ang tinta ko! Napakahusay."/move Wizard 1 0 1/pause 1000/speak Wizard "Er..."/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 500/showFrame Wizard 18/pause 500/speak Wizard "Nakita mo ba... ang dati kong asawa?#$b#Hindi? Kumusta naman ang bahay niya...?#$b#Sa tingin mo ba ay mag-isa siyang nakatira? O...$h"/pause 500/showFrame Wizard 0/emote Wizard 12/pause 500/faceDirection Wizard 3/pause 500/speak Wizard "...Sa totoo lang, huwag mo nang sabihin... Ayaw kong malaman."/pause 500/pause 500/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 500/speak Wizard "Tiyak na iniisip mo ang tungkol sa gantimpala mo. Heto..."/move Wizard -1 0 1/pause 800/faceDirection Wizard 2/pause 1000/showFrame Wizard 16/pause 800/specificTemporarySprite arcaneBook/playSound fireball/shake Wizard 500/pause 4000/faceDirection farmer 0/faceDirection Wizard 1/faceDirection Wizard 0/pause 500/speak Wizard "Isa itong aklat ng pagtawag.#$b#Napakalawak ng kapangyarihang arkano nito... pero gagawin ko itong simple para sa iyo.#$b#Sa paggamit ng aklat na ito, maaari kang magpalitaw ng mga mahiwagang gusali nang tuwiran sa bukid mo.#$b#Sa tingin ko ay magiging kapaki-pakinabang ito."/pause 500/faceDirection farmer 3/faceDirection Wizard 1/speak Wizard "O, halos makalimutan kong sabihin... ahem... Salamat."/pause 1000/emote farmer 32/pause 800/end
